baseline.name: Enumerate removable subarrays
baseline.approach: Extend each left boundary while maintaining the removed sum modulo p.

why: The needed earlier prefix remainder identifies a valid removal without enumerating every possible start. The latest matching index minimizes length for the current end.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline may consider n(n+1)/2 intervals. The archive performs up to two hash-chain operations per endpoint plus table initialization/cleanup; short-chain behavior is assumed for expected linear work, not a guaranteed speed ratio.
tradeoffs: Extra hash storage/init cost can dominate small n; collisions restore quadratic worst-case work. Positive p, nonnegative values, bounded sums and successful allocations are assumed.
evidence_basis: Static prefix-remainder invariant and hash-cost assumptions; no matched benchmark.
